capabilities: Translate selected text in PDFs and Markdown via an auto-popup window
Switch between Ollama local LLM, OpenAI-compatible cloud APIs, Google Translate, and Bing Translate
Translate text manually from a sidebar panel with language selection and copy/retry
Create and erase persistent PDF highlight annotations with notes
Configure custom translation prompts and language pairs
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not limited to LLMs; Google Translate and Bing Translate work with no configuration.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later; installed by downloading and running an install command in a terminal rather than from the community plugin directory. Free Google/Bing services have rate limits. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to translate text selected in its PDF reader or in Markdown notes, especially offline with a local model.

relations.evidence: Local LLM (Ollama) — Private, offline, unlimited usage
To connect llama-server, use Cloud API → OpenAI Compatible, which calls /v1/chat/completions
Google Translate / Bing Translate send selected text and language settings to Google or Microsoft translation services.
Google Translate / Bing Translate send selected text and language settings to Google or Microsoft translation services.

summary: LLM-powered translation plugin that translates selected text in PDF and Markdown files via Ollama, cloud APIs, Google Translate, or Bing Translate.
